article.title: OpenAI發布Images 2.6，加入GIF及API標註編輯
article.title_en: OpenAI releases Images 2.6 with GIF creation and API markup editing
article.summary: 11月4日公告把圖像更新帶到ChatGPT、Codex及API，開發者可選Flare或Sunburst。
article.summary_en: The November 4 announcement brings the image update to ChatGPT, Codex and the API, with Flare and Sunburst for developers.
highlights: 新增循環GIF創作，可用於角色動畫及社交素材。
API支援局部標註修改、SVG輸出及complexity參數。
highlights_en: GIF creation supports animated characters and social assets.
The API adds markup-guided edits, SVG output and a complexity control.
article.why: 創意團隊可把靜態概念延伸至短循環素材，並在同一工作流程內安排修改。
article.why_en: Creative teams can extend still concepts into short loops and organize revisions within one workflow.
article.next_step: 以一張已獲授權的品牌素材測試局部修改，逐項核對字樣、商品細節及輸出格式。
article.next_step_en: Test a targeted edit on an authorized brand asset, checking text, product details and output format.
article.detail: OpenAI稱，新版本可在多輪修改中更好保留角色、產品與品牌細節。這屬供應商對能力的描述，並不保證每次輸出完全一致。Flare與Sunburst是API的兩個選項；圖像品質與complexity分別控制視覺細節及場景規劃，不能混為同一設定。SVG輸出亦不代表檔案已符合印刷規格。帳戶及地區權限、字體與商標細節仍應在正式製作前核對。
article.detail_en: OpenAI describes improved detail retention across edits; this is a vendor claim, not a fidelity guarantee. API quality and complexity are distinct controls. SVG output still requires production checks, including fonts, logos and print specifications. Confirm account and regional access.
